plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to address concentration and preserve capital.
Keep SPY at 25% and QQQ at 14% for broad market exposure.
Sell all semiconductor and AI/Software holdings (SMH, CRWD, METU) to reduce risk.
Eliminate all leveraged ETFs (SOXL) to minimize volatility.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a focus on lower-risk assets.
Expect lower volatility and a more stable portfolio.
conservative.read: This mode aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and focusing on broader market exposure and income. Expect lower volatility but also capped upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to balance income and concentration.
Maintain SPY at 25% and QQQ at 14% for broad market exposure.
Sell SMH and METU to exit weak and leveraged positions.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce concentration in AI/Software.
Sell SOXL to reduce overall leveraged ETF exposure.
This plan seeks risk-first growth by blending broad markets with reduced tech concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by reducing risk while still seeking growth. It trims leverage and concentration, blending broad index exposure with quality tech and a small cash buffer. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration while retaining some income.
Maintain SPY at 25% and QQQ at 14% for broad market exposure.
Sell SMH to exit a weak semiconductor position.
Add to CRWD, increasing AI/Software exposure to 10%.
Sell METU to exit a leveraged AI/Software position.
Add SOXL to 6% to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
aggressive.read: This aggressive mode targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration, especially in tech. It accepts higher potential upside but also significantly increased drawdown risk due to leverage and potential ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to 10% to reduce broad market exposure.
Sell QQQ entirely to shift focus from growth to income.
Sell all semiconductor and AI/Software holdings (SMH, CRWD, METU) to cut risk.
Eliminate all leveraged ETFs (SOXL) to prioritize stability.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and capital preservation over growth.
income.read: This income-focused mode targets around 1% monthly return by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and high-beta single names, aiming for stable monthly distributions. While it offers income, NAV can still fall in market downturns.
